spans.s:
युयुक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Desid.), wish-
ing to join or unite; wishing to effect spiritual union
(with the divine essence), devout.

युयुजान, अस्, आ, अम् (Perf. Part. A.), one who
has yoked or joined.
—युयुजान-सप्ति, ई, m. du.,
Ved. having harnessed or yoked their horses (said of
the two Aśvins; Sāy. = रथे युज्यमानाश्वौ).
युयुत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing to fight.

युयुत्सा, f. (fr. the Desid.), the wishing to fight,
desire for war, eagerness for battle, pugnacity, enmity.
—युयुत्सा-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, without wish or in-
tention to fight, cowardly.

युयुत्सा युयुत्सा, युयुत्सु, युयुधान, &c.
See col. 1.

युयुत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to fight, desiring
war, eager for battle; anxious to fight with (with
inst. or with सह, सार्धम्, &c. with inst.); pug-
nacious, hostile, ambitious; (उस्), m. a combatant;
N. of one of the sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
युयुधन्, आ, m., N. of a king of Mithilā.

युयुधान, अस्, m., N. of a son of Satyaka, (he
was one of the allies of the Pāṇḍavas); a Kṣatriya,
warrior; epithet of Indra.

युयुधि or यूयुधि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. warlike,
martial, pugnacious.

युयु युयु, उस्, m. a horse, (probably incor-
rect for ययु.)
युयुक्खुर युयुक्-खुर, अस्, m. a hyena.
युयुवि युयुवि. See यूयुवि, p. 821, col. 2.

यूयुवि यूयुवि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. यु; ac-
cording to the Pada-pāṭha युयुवि), Ved. setting
aside, removing.
यूयम् यूयम्. See युष्मद्, p. 820, col. 3.
